about:
I'm Brayan Rosa da Silveira, a Full Stack Developer focused on web development — corporate websites, e-commerce platforms, internal systems, and REST APIs. I write clean, scalable code and ship products that solve real business problems.

I graduated in Computer Systems Analysis (CST) from Centro Universitário Santa Cruz de Curitiba and I'm currently studying IT Management at the same institution. I also hold certifications in Data Governance (ENAP) and English.

Before joining Lumicenter Lighting officially, I worked as a freelance developer for two years, building websites, web apps, and automations for clients. I started with a data & Power BI internship and grew into full-time full stack roles — mainly web platforms, internal tools, and API integrations.

I'm always learning, shipping side projects, and improving how I design APIs, dashboards, and modern user interfaces.
